therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Patients with stable coronary artery disease, including clopidogrel responders and non-responders
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Proportion of clopidogrel non-responders who responded (IPA >10% or >50%) to ticagrelor versus clopidogrel at Day 14/28, 4 hours post dose

results.effect_size: 100% of non-responders responded to ticagrelor (IPA>10%) vs 93.8% to clopidogrel; 81.3% vs 25.0% by IPA>50% definition
results.target_engagement_evidence: IPA measured by Light Transmittance Aggregometry (LTA); ticagrelor achieved higher IPA in non-responders
biomarker_changes: IPA (inhibition of platelet aggregation) >10%: ticagrelor 100% vs clopidogrel 93.8% in non-responders
IPA >50%: ticagrelor 81.3% vs clopidogrel 25.0% in non-responders
Clopidogrel responders switching to ticagrelor: IPA 95.0% (Day 15) and 77.4% (Day 28)
Clopidogrel responders remaining on clopidogrel: IPA 48.5% (Day 15) and 60.8% (Day 28)
subgroup_findings: In clopidogrel non-responders, ticagrelor achieved IPA>50% in 81.3% vs 25.0% for clopidogrel
In clopidogrel responders, switching to ticagrelor maintained or improved IPA compared to remaining on clopidogrel
safety_signals: Atrial fibrillation (1 event) in clopidogrel responders on ticagrelor non-switching period
Bradycardia (1 event) in clopidogrel responders on ticagrelor non-switching period
Ventricular extrasystoles (1 event) in clopidogrel responders on ticagrelor non-switching period
Myocardial infarction (1 event) in clopidogrel non-responders on ticagrelor non-switching period
Hypotension (1 event) in clopidogrel non-responders on ticagrelor non-switching period

dose_info.dose: Ticagrelor: 90 mg (180 mg loading); Clopidogrel: 75 mg (600 mg loading); Aspirin: 75–100 mg
dose_info.schedule: Ticagrelor: 180 mg loading then 90 mg twice daily for 2 weeks; Clopidogrel: 600 mg loading then 75 mg once daily for 2 weeks; Aspirin: once daily throughout

modulation_entries.hypothesis: Aspirin inhibits COX-1-mediated thromboxane A2 synthesis, providing complementary platelet inhibition that augments the P2Y12 blockade of ticagrelor
modulation_entries.citation: Aspirin obtained locally by the investigator, according to local practice. The dose remained constant throughout the study
